app.name: KS Beam
devices.title: TVs and projectors
devices.empty: No TVs or projectors found. Check that the TV is on and on the same Wi-Fi as this device, and that media sharing (DLNA) is turned on in its settings.
devices.firewall: If Windows asked whether to allow KS Beam, it must be allowed on private networks, or TVs can't find it. To change this: Windows Security, Firewall & network protection, Allow an app through firewall.
devices.choose: Choose a TV or projector to cast to.
cast.unsupported: KS Beam can't cast this kind of file. Choose a video, a music file or a photo.
cast.pending: Choose a TV or projector to cast {file}.
error.noResponse: The TV didn't respond. Check that it's still on and on the same Wi-Fi.
error.format: The TV can't play this file (error {code}). MP4 videos and MP3 music play on most TVs.
receiver.howTo: On your phone or computer, open KS Beam and choose {name}. Apps that cast with DLNA find it too.
receiver.noNetwork: Connect this TV to Wi-Fi or Ethernet to receive.
receiver.overApps: To show casts while another app is on screen, let KS Beam display over other apps.
